% Built-in Beamer declarations and ordinary LaTeX size/list scopes.
\documentclass[aspectratio=169]{beamer}
\setbeamertemplate{navigation symbols}{}
\begin{document}
\begin{frame}[plain,t]
  \onslide<1->Alpha\par
  \onslide<2->Beta\par
  \onslide<3->Gamma\par
\end{frame}
\begin{frame}[plain,t]
  Before\par
  \onslide+<2->Later\par
  \onslide Always\par
  \onslide*<3>{Only}\par
  \onslide<2->{Group} Tail\par
\end{frame}
\begin{frame}[plain,t]
  Before\par
  \begin{overprint}[120pt]
    \onslide<1|handout:0>Alpha.
    \onslide<2|handout:0>Beta.\par Second line.
    \onslide<3|handout:1>Gamma.
  \end{overprint}\par
  After\par
\end{frame}
\begin{frame}[plain,t]
  \begin{small}
    Alpha paragraph.
    \begin{itemize}
      \setlength{\itemsep}{1em}
      \item Beta
      \item Gamma
    \end{itemize}
  \end{small}
  Delta paragraph.
\end{frame}
\begin{frame}[t]
  \begin{small}Alpha\par
    \begin{footnotesize}Beta\par\end{footnotesize}
    Gamma\par
  \end{small}
  Delta\par
\end{frame}
\begin{frame}[plain,t]
  \small Alpha\par Beta\par
  \normalsize Gamma\par
  \begin{itemize}
    \setlength{\itemsep}{5pt plus 2pt minus 1pt}
    \item Delta
    \item Epsilon
  \end{itemize}
  \begin{itemize}\item Zeta\item Eta\end{itemize}
\end{frame}
\end{document}
